claims.evidence: No legible brand or model text is visible on the rubber, and exact size specifications are not shown in the photos.
Remaining tread depth measurement is not shown; the photo only shows dusty, worn tread grooves.
History of punctures, repairs, or internal damage is not shown in the photos.
Tire manufacturing date or age is not shown in the photos.

risks.risk: Tire age or manufacturing date is unknown; rubber may be expired or degraded.
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the DOT code on the sidewall.

risks.risk: Remaining tread depth is unknown; it may be below legal or usable limit.
risks.proof: Photo of a tread depth gauge inserted in the grooves, or close-up of tread wear bars.
risks.if_unproven: priced as worn or minimum-tread tire

risks.risk: Tire may not hold air pressure; slow leaks or bead issues may exist.
risks.proof: Video of the tire inflated and holding pressure, or a leak-test clip.

risks.risk: Hidden internal damage, patches, or bulges may not be visible externally.
risks.proof: Inspection of the tire interior or an inflation clip showing no bulge and no air loss.

risks.risk: Exact size may not be 295/40 R20 and may not fit the buyer's rim.
risks.proof: Close-up photo of sidewall size markings.

proof_requests: Close-up of sidewall showing DOT code and size markings
Video of tire inflated holding air
Confirmation of no patches, bulges, or repairs
response.reason: The witness identifies the item as a used car tire, so a worst-case price is possible; every seller claim about size, brand, tread, condition, and age is unverifiable from the photos.
